title: Sound Sails Mystic

services.name: Book a Sail
services.desc: End your day the Mystic way - a sunset charter is a coastal ritual that offers golden skies and quiet harbors in perfect harmony. Our most popular experience, the sunset sail is perfect for those looking to unwind and take in the natural beauty of Mystic, Connecticut. As the sun sets over the water, the atmosphere becomes calm, scenic, and unforgettable. This is a great option for couples, special occasions, or anyone looking for a peaceful evening on the water. A sunset sail offers an upscale and private way to unwind and enjoy the views of Mystic, Fishers Island and Groton Long

quotes.text: I could not speak more highly of my experience with Sound Sails. Kali and team gave me and my family a wonderful experience on a leisurely sail around fisher’s island sound. They were very accommodating with a group of all ages, and they clearly knew what they were doing. We were also able to bring a nice picnic. Looking forward to our next cruise.

Thank you Kali and crew! You were awesome! We had a great time sailing on Loki. Your historic knowledge of the area and patience with us getting on and off the boat were greatly appreciated. We love sailing at sunset and would highly recommend this charter experience to anyone!
I booked this cruise for my son’s birthday and we had a great time, even saw some seals on the rocks. We brought sandwiches from Mystic Market and some beverages, it was memorable. We’ll be back.
